thread:
sasha: Heads-up — starting LynxBridge LoRA merge (cust-runs) into base-1.2. Plan: quick eval pack (50 prompts) with 4-bit quant to surface any token/behavior drift. tagging @maria @oliver for tokenizer/merge checks.

maria: ack. which branch + PR? also need the exact prompt set (send as gist).

sasha: PR: feat/lynxbridge-lora-merge. quickpack config attached below. running on a small dedicated slot first.

oliver: FYI we saw token offsets on a previous customer when adapter used byte-level vs gpt2 tokens. keep an eye on emojis and code fences.

sasha: copying the run command so anyone can reproduce:
```bash
./eval_harness --config quickpack/lynxbridge.yaml --model merged/lynxbridge-base-1.2-lora --quant 4bit --seed 42
```

ci-bot: pipeline #8742 triggered for feat/lynxbridge-lora-merge (linux-x64, gpu:rtx6000).

deploy-bot: reserved dedicated slot on dev-dedicated-02 for 30m window.

maria: quick note — set `tokenizer_remap: true` in the config if you want automatic token alignment. It helped with the emoji shift last week.

ryan: if remap doesn't fix it, try `merge_mode: no-stitch` to isolate whether adapter stitching is causing KV misalignment.

sasha: first smoke done. posting truncated metrics: helpfulness_delta: -0.03, hallucination_rate: +0.08, exact_match (qa subset): -1.2%. Many failures concentrated on short QA and code-format prompts. :eyes:

oliver: can you paste a failing example?

sasha: failing prompt 12 from pack:
"""
Prompt: "What's the output of `sum([1,2,3])` in python?"
Golden: "6"
Model: "6
Also, you can use reduce(...) for more complex sums."
"""
Behavior seems to append explanatory text where baseline didn't. Not huge but impacts exact_match.

maria: small explanations are likely from adapter's instruction tuning. For QA EM we should allow short answer mode — add `max_explain_tokens: 0` as a quick mitigation. But tokenizer drift is still concerning.

sasha: ran with `tokenizer_remap: true` + `max_explain_tokens: 0` -> hallucination_rate dropped to +0.03 and EM recovered by 0.7%. Still not baseline.

ryan: try rerunning the same eval with 8-bit quant (q8) to rule out aggressive 4-bit quantization causing precision issues.

sasha: queued q8 run. also noticed tokenization shift on emoji sequences: "👍🏽" -> split differently, causing alignment mismatch in short string comparisons.

oliver: that's classic. customer used a pre-tokenized dataset with custom special tokens. We should run `tokenizer_diff --base base-1.2 --cust merged/lynxbridge` to output the mapping and a small patch.

maria: I'll run tokenizer_diff and generate remap table. If it's extensive we might ask the customer to re-export with tokenizer metadata.

ci-bot: pipeline #8742 -> step test-quickpack failed (step 4: em-check).

sasha: attaching a minimal repro that shows token offset in code fences and emoji.

ryan: if the remap is small, we can include it as a lightweight preprocessing step in the serving runtime: on-request token remap before encode. That avoids forcing a customer re-export. But we should measure perf cost.

maria: remap table generated. 14 entries, mostly multi-codepoint emoji and a custom <cust_cmd> token. sending table to the thread.

sasha: re-ran quickpack with remap+q8+no-explain. Metrics now: helpfulness_delta: -0.005, hallucination_rate: +0.01, EM: -0.3%. Improvement but still some edge cases on multi-turn code edits.

oliver: curious — does KV-cache alignment change when switching merge_mode? Any drift on multi-turn token indexes?

sasha: quick smoke with `merge_mode: no-stitch` shows EM -0.1% and hallucination +0.02% — slightly better in one-off QA but worse for longform. So stitching affects longform coherence but may introduce token-index shifts.

maria: suggested path: 1) ship tokenizer remap as server-side patch 2) for LynxBridge, set default `max_explain_tokens: 0` for QA routes 3) keep merge in canary for 24h and watch rollup evals.

ryan: agree. also schedule a short customers sync — we should be transparent about the small regression and the remediation plan.

sasha: creating internal ticket KEY-423 (lynxbridge-lora-token-remap) and a canary rollout plan. Holding off on promoting to prod until 24h canary and cust signoff.

maria: pinging @support to prep a brief customer note with steps and ETA.

oliver: one more thing — add an eval metric that tolerates short explanatory tokens for QA so we don't flag non-actionable regressions. call it `em_strict` vs `em_fuzzy`.

sasha: done. adding `em_fuzzy` to quickpack. will re-run overnight.

deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: dev -> canary-lynxbridge at 2026-03-21T02:15Z.

sasha: thanks all. short checklist posted in KEY-423. will update thread after 24h. :shipit:
